MOTION TO CONSOLIDATE ACTIONS OF CASE(S) CUD-26-682209, CUD-26-682276, CUD-26-682354, CUD-26-682355 WITH CASE CGC-26-636886
Off Calendar Aug-17-2026 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: APPEARANCES:

David Silverman plaintiff appearing in pro per.
Luke Garvey appearing as counsel for defendant.

Mr. Silverman contests the courts tentative ruling. Argued. After reviewing the pleadings and listening to oral arguments the Court adopts the tentative ruling as follows:

MOTION TO CONSOLIDATE ACTIONS OF CASE(S) CUD-26-682209, CUD-26-682276, CUD-26-682354, CUD-26-682355 WITH CASE CGC-26-636886

is DENIED. Actions CUD-26-682354 and CUD-26-682355 have been dismissed. Moving party fails to cite any authority for the proposition that civil actions may be consolidated with the summary unlawful detainer proceedings (which prohibit cross-complaints) for termination of tenancy and forcible detainer.

Order signed. Judge: Samuel K. Feng; Clerk: L. Young ; Not Reported. (D501)
